title: Resume after crash before the job intent is recorded
narrative: Fangore's host is dispatching a remote coding job on a durable plan. The MechaHarness process dies before the job intent is written. After restart he opens the same durable store, resumes the plan from the last checkpoint, and verifies the remote job is submitted exactly once — no prior effect to reconcile, and dispatch does not double. Sibling crash windows: `fangore_tdr_crash_after_intent_before_call`, `fangore_tdr_crash_after_accept_before_record`, and later accept/reduce/commit stories. Complements `fangore_insp_durable_resume` fingerprint refusal. Tracks transactional durable resume[^tdr-req] and MH-PA-05[^insp-pa-05].
implementation: `ArmedCrashProbe` + SQLite checkpoint durable resume for coding_job effects. `CliInstrumentor` probe `transactional_durable_resume`. Unit: `tests/fixtures/transactional_durable_resume/*.json`.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/crash_before_intent.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
